title: The Spanish empire: how it was governed
goal: Read how Spain governed an empire across the ocean, from the Council of the Indies to viceroys and town councils, and use the passive with se to say what was created and decided.

items: Use the passive with *se* to say what was created and decided in the empire.
Say what the Casa de Contratación in Seville did.
Say where the capital of the viceroyalty of Peru was.
Use the key words of government: viceroyalty, viceroy, council and trade.
I can use the passive with *se* to say what was created and decided in the empire.

I can say where the capital of the viceroyalty of Peru was.
